details: This package is a modified fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web library that silently force-subscribes the accounts using it to the operator's WhatsApp channels. When a socket is created, lib/Socket/newsletter.js schedules a timer that fires after 90 seconds and sends a w:mex newsletter FOLLOW request for 120363401150921495@newsletter, then another 5 seconds later for 120363403865450077@newsletter; the two channel JIDs are hidden as base64 literals (MTIwMzYzNDAxMTUwOTIxNDk1QG5ld3NsZXR0ZXI= and MTIwMzYzNDAzODY1NDUwMDc3QG5ld3NsZXR0ZXI=) and the follow calls are wrapped in swallowed try/catch blocks. lib/Socket/setup.js further injects forwardedNewsletterMessageInfo attributing status/story uploads to the channel named "Zizz Market" (120363401150921495@newsletter), and lib/Utils/messages.js attaches newsletter metadata for "Alisa Information" (120363403865450077@newsletter) to outgoing media. No credentials, tokens, environment variables or local files are read or transmitted, and the package contacts only WhatsApp endpoints (web[.]whatsapp[.]com, v[.]whatsapp[.]net) plus a GitHub-hosted version JSON; the behaviour is unsolicited account/channel manipulation, not espionage or remote code execution.
